public_rationale: Rentosertib's published trial results and subsequent Phase III start are meaningful progress. They do not meet the stated early-resolution rule for substantial realized impact on drug design. Marcus gave no deadline and explicitly allowed future techniques, so the absence of a decisive event by 2026-10-28 cannot count as failure.
limitations: The threshold for substantial impact is an evaluator interpretation.
The evidence search is not an exhaustive census of every AI-assisted drug-design program.
A company milestone announcement cannot by itself establish industry-wide productivity gains.

criteria.support_condition: Public evidence establishes substantial, sustained changes in drug-design productivity or practice attributable to AI, or substantial therapeutic output from AI-designed drugs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period without success contradicts this unrestricted eventual forecast. An adverse trial result or failure of current techniques is insufficient.
